sm_top.sm: Houthi missile and drone attacks targeted locations in Aden.
The death toll rises from a Houthi strike on a Yemen training camp.
The UK announced it will deploy Typhoon fighter jets to defend Saudi Arabia following Houthi missile and drone attacks.
Iran's Revolutionary Guard Corps stated that naval mines halted two tankers crossing the Strait of Hormuz.
Ukrainian drone strikes targeted St. Petersburg and Leningrad Oblast, causing fires at an oil terminal and logistics hub.
The Saudi-led coalition intercepted incoming drones and missiles over Saudi Arabia and the Red Sea.
A tugboat was struck by projectiles off the coast of the UAE, resulting in one injury.
Russia launched a major overnight missile and drone attack targeting Ukraine's energy infrastructure, causing damage and power outages.
Ukrainian drone attacks have struck and halted operations at Russian oil refineries, including in Ryazan.
Airstrikes near the Sudan-Egypt border killed 72 gold miners.
Reports state the US failed to warn Ukraine about a Russian ballistic missile attack on Kyiv.
Romanian fighter jets shot down drones over territorial waters.
Russian missile and drone attacks across Ukraine killed 9 people.
Ongoing Israeli airstrikes in Gaza have resulted in multiple Palestinian casualties, including deaths and injuries.
Protests were held condemning a reported airstrike in Saada.
US CENTCOM stated that Iranian claims about oil tankers colliding with sea mines in the Strait of Hormuz are false.
A Houthi strike hit southern Saudi Arabia, injuring six people.
Escalating fighting in Yemen, including coalition airstrikes, has resulted in hundreds of casualties and mounting pressure on the health system.
Houthi forces struck the Aramco headquarters in Dhahran, Saudi Arabia, causing fires at the facility.
Drone strikes and interceptions occur in Khartoum and across Sudan.
Satellite images show Russia built a major new drone attack base in six weeks.
A paramilitary drone strike near the Sudanese-Ethiopian border killed 41 people, according to a rights group.
The death toll from a Houthi attack on a military training camp in Yemen rose to 73.
At least 40 civilians were killed in northern Mali following attacks attributed to the Islamic State.
NATO and allied support aircraft continue Steadfast Noon nuclear exercise activity over Italy.
A drone strike on an Abyei market left at least 53 people dead, prompting Juba to summon the Sudanese Ambassador.
Houthi forces fired ballistic missiles towards Yemen, while the Saudi-led coalition targeted Houthi missile launch platforms.
Russia launched 165 drones at Ukraine, with 115 neutralized and hits recorded at 30 locations.
Yemen urged the UN Security Council to formally condemn Houthi attacks following a strike near the Maashiq Palace in Aden that killed five people.
Saudi-led coalition airstrikes in Yemen resulted in civilian casualties and neutralized Houthi fighters.
Russian forces claim to have captured Dobropillya, while Ukrainian officials reject the claim and report troop withdrawals.
UNICEF reported that over 340 children have been killed in Gaza since the ceasefire.
Yemeni forces clashed with Houthi forces in Taiz amid reported Houthi losses.
Russian forces struck four cargo ships and two logistics centers in Ukraine.
Iran's navy claims US forces struck the Konarak naval base, wounding two soldiers, following reports of blasts in the area.
The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps conducted military exercises involving ballistic missile test launches in Iran.
Saudi-led coalition airstrikes hit oil facilities in Yemen, prompting Houthi warnings of retaliation.
A Russian drone strike hits a park in the Kharkiv region, killing six people.
A drone strike near a displacement camp in Sudan's Blue Nile state killed at least 30 people, mostly women and children.
A drone strike in a disputed Sudan-South Sudan area killed dozens of people, according to a minister.
